sql: CREATE VIEW reporting.v_airpods_weekly_demand AS SELECT TRY_CAST(Week_Ending AS DATE) AS Week_Ending, CAST(Units_Sold AS DOUBLE) AS Units_Sold FROM demand.airpods_weekly_2019;

CREATE VIEW reporting.v_forecast_lead_time_baseline AS SELECT TRY_CAST(Forecast_Origin AS DATE) AS Forecast_Origin, TRY_CAST(Forecast_Week AS DATE) AS Forecast_Week, Lead_Time_Weeks, Model, Forecast_Weekly_Units, Cumulative_Forecast_Units, Scenario_Type FROM demand.forecast_lead_time_baseline_2019;

CREATE VIEW reporting.v_forecast_model_performance AS (SELECT 'AirPods Weekly Units' AS Experiment, 'Units' AS Target_Unit, Model, CAST(MAE AS DOUBLE) AS MAE, CAST("WAPE (%)" AS DOUBLE) AS WAPE_Pct, CAST(Bias AS DOUBLE) AS Bias FROM demand.model_performance_rolling_2019) UNION ALL (SELECT 'Apple Headphone Daily Purchase Events' AS Experiment, 'Events' AS Target_Unit, Model, CAST(MAE AS DOUBLE) AS MAE, CAST("WAPE (%)" AS DOUBLE) AS WAPE_Pct, CAST(Bias AS DOUBLE) AS Bias FROM ecommerce.demand_sensing_model_comparison_2019);
CREATE VIEW reporting.v_forecast_multihorizon_performance AS SELECT Horizon_Weeks, Model, Forecasts, MAE, WAPE_Pct, Bias, Rank FROM demand.forecast_multihorizon_performance_2019;

CREATE VIEW reporting.v_headphone_daily_signals AS SELECT TRY_CAST(Event_Date AS DATE) AS Event_Date, CAST("Views" AS BIGINT) AS "Views", CAST(Cart_Events AS BIGINT) AS Cart_Events, CAST(Purchases AS BIGINT) AS Recorded_Purchase_Events, CAST(Purchases_For_Analysis AS DOUBLE) AS Purchases_For_Analysis, Purchase_Anomaly_Flag, CASE  WHEN ((Purchase_Anomaly_Flag = true)) THEN ('Suspected Recording Anomaly') ELSE 'Unflagged' END AS Quality_Status FROM ecommerce.apple_headphones_daily_2019;
CREATE VIEW reporting.v_inventory_candidate_actions AS SELECT Scenario, "Action", Fill_Rate_Pct, Illustrative_Exposure_USD, Total_Outstanding_Units FROM inventory.inventory_candidate_actions;

CREATE VIEW reporting.v_inventory_launch_readiness AS SELECT Scenario, "Action", Total_Shortage, Shortage_Weeks, Fill_Rate_Pct, Readiness_Status, Illustrative_Exposure_USD, Exposure_Reduction_vs_No_Action_USD, Total_Outstanding_Units FROM inventory.inventory_launch_readiness;

CREATE VIEW reporting.v_inventory_scenario_performance AS SELECT Scenario, Total_Demand, Total_Fulfilled, Total_Shortage, Receipts_In_Horizon, Shortage_Weeks, Ending_Inventory, Fill_Rate_Pct FROM inventory.inventory_scenario_performance;

CREATE VIEW reporting.v_inventory_weekly AS SELECT Scenario, "Week", Forecast_Week, Beginning_Inventory, Inbound_Receipts, Demand_Units, Fulfilled_Units, Shortage_Units, Ending_Inventory, Weekly_Fill_Rate_Pct FROM inventory.inventory_weekly_simulation;

CREATE VIEW reporting.v_purchase_intent_models AS SELECT Model, Feature_Group, CAST(Accuracy AS DOUBLE) AS Accuracy, CAST("Precision" AS DOUBLE) AS "Precision", CAST(Recall AS DOUBLE) AS Recall, CAST(F1 AS DOUBLE) AS F1, CAST(ROC_AUC AS DOUBLE) AS ROC_AUC FROM intent.purchase_intent_model_leaderboard;

CREATE VIEW reporting.v_retail_monthly_demand AS SELECT TRY_CAST("Month" AS DATE) AS "Month", CAST(Units_Sold AS DOUBLE) AS Units_Sold, CAST(Total_Orders AS BIGINT) AS Total_Orders, CAST(Unique_Products AS BIGINT) AS Unique_Products, Calendar_Days, Days_With_Sales, Recorded_Day_Pct, Coverage_Review_Status FROM retail.retail_monthly_demand;
CREATE VIEW reporting.v_sensitivity_action_robustness AS SELECT * FROM sensitivity.sensitivity_action_robustness;
CREATE VIEW reporting.v_sensitivity_decision_cases AS SELECT * FROM sensitivity.sensitivity_decision_cases;
CREATE VIEW reporting.v_sensitivity_decision_coverage AS SELECT * FROM sensitivity.sensitivity_decision_coverage;
